prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity decision comp for a web-app redesign
Primary request: Create one 16:9 presentation image showing TWO complete Wicker Study desktop app screens side by side, Settings on the left and Documents on the right. Direction: Academic Archive Runway.
Input image: reference image supplies the exact Wicker Study app chrome, warm neutral canvas, narrow typography, indigo action color, flat ruled white panels, 14px major corners, sidebar proportions, density, and component character. Do not copy its Courses content.
Screen 1, Settings: persistent Wicker sidebar with Documents under MANAGE, page title "Settings", flat local tabs Profile, Connections, API access, AI usage, Data & privacy with Connections active. One broad white connection register with edge-to-edge header and rows. Canvas row uses actual red Canvas LMS mark, connected origin and indexing permission. Timetable row shows a live calendar feed, appointment count and refresh state. Buttons manage each in place.
Screen 2, Documents: persistent same sidebar with Documents active. Page title "Documents", short subtitle, Upload document primary action. A near-black full-width "Academic record runway" spans the top of content, showing a dated degree journey through v1, v2, v3 and current position, with compact figures "96 ECTS", "18 courses passed", "7.6 average". Below, ruled document groups for Transcript, Academic Work and Academic calendar; each row shows current version and a thin horizontal series of dated version stops, plus View history, Replace and Remove actions. All internal rules reach panel edges.
Style/medium: production SaaS UI screenshot, crisp vector-like interface, not a poster and not a device mockup.
Composition: both screens large and readable, equal scale, minimal outer margin, desktop landscape.
Text (verbatim where prominent): "Settings", "Connections", "Canvas", "Timetable", "Documents", "Upload document", "Academic record runway", "Transcript", "Academic Work", "Academic calendar", "View history".
Constraints: no gradients, no glass, no colorful cards, no serif, no decorative eyebrows, no floating short dividers, no nested card stack, no em dash, neutral and indigo only except Canvas vendor red. The dark runway is one decisive emphasis plane, not decorative acreage.
